capture_rules: Capture the actual iOS app on an iPhone or iOS Simulator.
Use a clean dedicated review universe with no personal data or credentials visible.
Do not resize or frame Android screenshots as iPhone output.
Keep status bars, safe areas, and native rendering truthful to the captured device.
Do not show debug UI, transient errors, notification banners, or microphone indicators unless the scene explains voice.

shots.proof: TinyAssets opens directly into the same persistent universe on iPhone.
A user message and useful universe response are visible without private content.
The app shows real multi-step work rather than a generic chatbot claim.
Users bring their own AI provider; no secret material is visible.
Privacy information and account deletion are reachable in-app.
